name: Generous body line height
definition: Is body text set with a line height of roughly 1.5 or more of the font size?

name: Single font family, no web fonts
definition: Does the page use only one font family (typically a system font stack) for all text with no web fonts loaded?

name: Large bold H1 with defined heading scale
definition: Is the h1 large and bold with a clearly smaller bold h2 forming a distinct heading scale?

name: Small uppercase letter-spaced labels
definition: Are small uppercase letter-spaced labels used for categories, metadata, stats, or list/group headings?

name: Uppercase tracked eyebrow label above heading
definition: Does a small uppercase, letter-spaced eyebrow or kicker label sit above section headings or the main headline?

name: Two-color split heading
definition: Is a heading split into two colors or weights within one headline, such as an accent-colored line or word?

name: Uppercase tracked nav and button labels
definition: Are navigation, button, badge or footer labels set in uppercase with letter-spacing?

name: Serif body paired with sans headings
definition: Is a serif face used for body or descriptive text while headings, nav and UI use a sans-serif?

name: Light or regular-weight large headings
definition: Are large headings set in light or regular weight rather than bold?

name: All-caps large section headings
definition: Are headings set in large all-caps type?

name: Heavy condensed display face for headings
definition: Does the page pair a body sans with a heavy condensed display typeface for headings?

name: Italic serif tagline or secondary text
definition: Is italic text used for taglines, secondary links or disclaimers?

name: Sentence-case titles contrasting all-caps labels
definition: Do card or article titles use sentence case in contrast with all-caps labels or headings?

name: Serif display headings with sans body
definition: Are headings set in a serif display face while body and UI text use a sans-serif?

name: White hero headline on dark or photo
definition: Is the hero headline large white type over a dark, colored or photo background?

name: Bold labels with little prose
definition: Is bold text used heavily for names and labels with little paragraph prose?

name: Extreme type scale contrast
definition: Is there extreme contrast between huge display headings and small body text with few intermediate sizes?

name: Headings at body size
definition: Are section headings set at body size or only modestly larger so hierarchy is weak?

name: Lead paragraph then smaller body
definition: Does intro text use a larger lighter lead paragraph followed by smaller darker body text?

name: Meta text such as bylines is very small, gray sans with a mi
definition: Meta text such as bylines is very small, gray sans with a middle-dot separator.

name: Navy-colored headings
definition: Are headings colored dark navy rather than black?

name: Three-face type system with script accents
definition: Does the page combine a sans body, a serif heading face and a handwritten script accent face?

name: Underlined inline links
definition: Are inline links within paragraphs underlined?

name: Single saturated accent color reused
definition: Does the page use one single saturated accent color consistently for buttons, links, badges and similar key elements?

name: Near-black text instead of pure black
definition: Is body or heading text a tinted near-black, dark slate or charcoal rather than pure black?

name: Muted tinted secondary text color
definition: Is secondary text (dates, labels, footer copy) set in a muted gray, grey-blue or tinted color?

name: Alternating light section background bands
definition: Do section backgrounds alternate between white and a pale tint or other colors to separate content bands?

name: Blue and navy dominant palette
definition: Is the palette built primarily on blues and deep navy?

name: Dark theme with layered dark surfaces
definition: Does the page use a dark background with slightly lighter dark surfaces for cards and bands?

name: Warm earthy or cream palette
definition: Is the palette warm and earthy, with cream, off-white backgrounds and warm accent hues?

name: Monochrome single-hue palette
definition: Is the palette built on a single hue family (e.g. teal or green tones)?

name: Status colors by metric threshold
definition: Are metric values colored by threshold (green, orange, red)?

name: Centered fixed-width content container
definition: Is the main content constrained to a centered fixed-width container narrower than the viewport with side margins?

name: Header with logo left and nav right
definition: Is the header a bar with logo at left and navigation links (possibly with CTA, dropdowns or utilities) at right?

name: Alternating section background bands
definition: Do full-width section backgrounds alternate between colors (e.g. white and a tint) to separate content bands?

name: Footer with divider and bottom row
definition: Does the footer have a thin divider above a bottom row with copyright/legal links and other items?

name: Two-column hero with image or form
definition: Is the hero a two-column split with text on one side and an image, photo, form or cards on the other?

name: Uses both CSS grid and flexbox
definition: Does the layout combine CSS grid and flexbox containers (without one clearly dominating)?

name: Multi-column dark footer
definition: Is the footer a dark multi-column block of links and headings?

name: Three-column card grid
definition: Are cards arranged in a three-column row/grid?

name: Container with full-bleed breakout sections
definition: Does content sit in a centered container while hero, photo or color bands run full-bleed to the page edge?

name: Generous vertical section spacing
definition: Is there generous vertical padding between sections?

name: Left-aligned hero text block
definition: Is the hero content left-aligned with a large headline, optional subtitle and a button or tagline?

name: Narrow paragraph measure leaving empty side
definition: Are prose paragraphs or intro text constrained to a narrower width than the container, leaving the other side empty?

name: Split section with text left, list or cards right
definition: Is there a two-column section pairing heading/intro text with a list or card grid on the other side?

name: Two-column split section, image and text
definition: Is there a two-column split section with an image or photo on one side and text/CTA on the other?

name: Uneven card heights in a row
definition: Do cards in a row have uneven heights leaving blank space beneath shorter ones?

name: Centered intro with single CTA
definition: Is there a minimal centered section with a heading, short text and a single call-to-action button?

name: Four-column grid with empty last row
definition: Is there a four-column card grid with incomplete rows leaving empty columns?

name: Long vertically stacked page
definition: Is the page long, spanning several viewport heights with many sequential sections or entries?

name: Main column with side sidebar
definition: Does the layout have a main content column beside a narrower sidebar?

name: Section header with eyebrow or split subtitle
definition: Do section headers use an eyebrow label or place heading and subtitle on a split row?

name: Three-part header with centered element
definition: Is the header split into left, centered and right parts?

name: Alternating image-text split rows
definition: Do image-and-text rows alternate which side the image sits on?

name: Grid dominates over flexbox
definition: Does the layout rely mainly on CSS grid rather than flexbox?

name: Light or two-column contact footer
definition: Is the footer or contact area a light/white two-column block with contact or social details?

name: Equal-height cards in a row
definition: Do cards in a row stretch to equal height regardless of text length?

name: Flexbox dominates over grid
definition: Does the layout rely mainly on flexbox with few grid containers?

name: Hero with stats row and pill CTA
definition: Does the hero show headline, muted description and stats row with a pill CTA on the right?

name: Link-dense page
definition: Does the page have many anchors and list items relative to body text?

name: Little grid or flex, simple block flow
definition: Does the page use almost no grid or flex, relying on simple stacked block flow?

name: Media section with large thumbnail and list
definition: Does a section pair one large video/image thumbnail with a stacked list of smaller cards?

name: Mixed alignment and shifting edges
definition: Do alignment edges, heading alignment and container widths shift between sections rather than following one grid?

name: Multi-column gallery or thumbnail grid
definition: Is there a multi-column grid of image thumbnails in framed tiles?

name: Side-by-side secondary sections
definition: Do secondary sections sit side by side in two columns?

name: Stacked FAQ cards in narrow column
definition: Is FAQ content shown as stacked expanded cards in a narrow centered column?

name: Text-only hero without photo
definition: Is the hero text-only with no photograph or imagery?

name: Text-only sections with eyebrow and button
definition: Are there text-only sections with eyebrow, short heading, subline and button and no imagery?

name: Tiles anchored text and edge-to-edge
definition: Do split tiles run edge to edge with text anchored at the bottom left?

name: White bordered rounded cards
definition: Are cards white with thin borders and rounded corners, with no heavy shadow?

name: Fully rounded pill primary buttons
definition: Are the primary call-to-action buttons fully rounded pills?

name: Image-top cards with title
definition: Do cards stack an image on top followed by title and text in a consistent order?

name: Logo-left nav-right header
definition: Does the header place the logo at left and navigation links at right?

name: Email signup form
definition: Is there a simple email signup form with an input and a button?

name: Outlined ghost buttons
definition: Are secondary or all buttons transparent or outlined with a thin border rather than filled?

name: Thin top utility bar
definition: Is there a thin utility bar above the header holding secondary links, contact details or similar?

name: Dark footer band
definition: Is the footer a dark band with light text?

name: Full-width announcement bar
definition: Is there a full-width announcement bar at the top of the page carrying a short message or link?

name: Quick-link tile grid
definition: Is there a grid of quick-link tiles or columns?

name: Styled inline text links
definition: Are inline links colored or underlined in a consistent accent style?

name: Labeled form fields
definition: Do forms use visible labels with native inputs and selects?

name: Minimal footer legal row
definition: Is the footer or its bottom row minimal, with copyright, a few links or payment icons?

name: Pill chips and filter tabs
definition: Are there pill-shaped chips, filters or tags as a row?

name: Ruled divider lists
definition: Are lists separated by thin horizontal divider lines?

name: Search form with input and button
definition: Is there a prominent search form pairing an input with a button?

name: Thick left accent border blocks
definition: Do cards or callouts have a thick accent-colored left border?

name: Arrow-terminated text links
definition: Are secondary calls to action text links ending in an arrow glyph rather than buttons?

name: Full-width promo or CTA band
definition: Is there a full-width colored or gray promotional band with a heading or text and a call to action?

name: Mostly square corners, no pills
definition: Are corners predominantly square or slightly rounded, with no pill shapes?

name: Section heading with View All link
definition: Do section headings have a right-aligned 'View all' style link?

name: Square or small-radius solid buttons
definition: Are the primary buttons solid rectangles with square or small-radius corners?

name: Sticky overlay header
definition: Is the header sticky or fixed, overlaying content, possibly translucent?

name: Text wordmark brand
definition: Is the brand shown as a text wordmark instead of a logo image?

name: Text-only social links
definition: Are social links plain text labels without icons?

name: Cards without images
definition: Are cards or tiles text-only, with no thumbnails or photos?

name: Carousel
definition: Does the page have a carousel or slider?

name: Circular avatars
definition: Are circular avatars or author photos used?

name: Dark feature cards
definition: Are there dark-filled cards or tiles with white text?

name: Dark inputs with placeholders
definition: Are form inputs dark-filled boxes, possibly without visible labels?

name: Full-width sidebar or form button
definition: Is there a button spanning the full width of its form or card?

name: Highlighted active nav item
definition: Is the active navigation item visually highlighted as a tab or fill?

name: Icon social links
definition: Are social links presented as icons or icon-plus-label items?

name: Numbered pagination
definition: Is there numbered pagination with a highlighted current page?

name: Person or community cards
definition: Are there cards for people or communities showing name and a secondary line?

name: Pill category badges on cards
definition: Do cards carry small pill-shaped badges or tags?

name: Square-cornered label badges
definition: Are badges or labels sharp-cornered rectangles?

name: A wide gray banner cross-promotes a related product line wit
definition: A wide gray banner cross-promotes a related product line with a button.

name: Accessibility aids
definition: Are accessibility aids such as text-size controls present?

name: Back-to-top link
definition: Does the page end with a centered back-to-top link with an arrow?

name: Bold accent product prices
definition: Are product names bold dark and prices bold accent pinned to card bottom?

name: Centered icon cards
definition: Do cards center an icon, uppercase title and description?

name: Circular check bullet list
definition: Does the hero list benefits with circular check icons?

name: Detached photo credit caption
definition: Is photo credit a small dark caption box detached from its image?

name: Each section heading has a dark horizontal rule beneath it,
definition: Each section heading has a dark horizontal rule beneath it, with a right-aligned 'All … →' link on the label line.

name: Empty card bodies
definition: Do some cards have empty bodies leaving blank space?

name: Footer link sequence numbers
definition: Do footer links carry small numbers after each label?

name: Gradient or color band logo statement
definition: Is there a colored band with a logo above a centered white statement?

name: Hidden dialog form
definition: Is a hidden dialog or modal with a labeled form in the DOM?

name: Italic serif pull quote
definition: Are pull quotes italic serif blockquotes with a colored left border?

name: Language selector buttons
definition: Is there a language selector with flag buttons?

name: Logo on rounded tile
definition: Does the logo sit on a rounded white tile with a shadow?

name: Minimal logo-only header
definition: Is the header just a logo at far left with no nav?

name: Mobile-only menu toggle
definition: Is there a menu toggle hidden on desktop?

name: Multi-column cream footer with newsletter
definition: Is the footer a cream multi-column block with tracked uppercase headings and newsletter?

name: News rows with date block
definition: Do news rows show a date block, headline and read-more link in a row?

name: Numbered step cards
definition: Is there a row of cards with numbered circle badges?

name: Photo band with overlay text
definition: Is there a full-width photo band with dark overlay and centered text?

name: Square-cornered accent search button
definition: Is there a flat inverted promo button on a banner?

name: Statistics tile grid
definition: Are statistics shown as a grid of tiles with large numbers?

name: Struck-through old price
definition: Does pricing show a struck-through old price beside a larger new price?

name: Testimonial cards with stars
definition: Are testimonials equal-height cards with star ratings and no photos?

name: Text-only auth buttons panel
definition: Are auth options text-only buttons in a bordered panel?

name: Trending strip
definition: Is there a trending strip with an accent label and truncated post titles?

name: Minimal decoration, no gradients or animation
definition: Is decoration minimal, with no gradients, blur, animations or transforms and few shadows or transitions?

name: Square corners dominate, small radii only
definition: Are most corners square, with only small radii (a few px) and no large or pill rounding?

name: Single hero gradient
definition: Is the hero background a gradient, typically the page's only gradient?

name: Short accent underline bar under headings
definition: Do section headings have a short accent-colored rule or underline bar beneath them?

name: Full-width hairline rules between sections
definition: Are sections or headings separated by thin horizontal rules or alternating background tones?

name: Motion limited to simple transitions
definition: Is motion limited to simple CSS transitions, with no keyframe animations, transforms or backdrop blur?

name: Pill buttons with otherwise square corners
definition: Are buttons fully rounded pills while most other elements stay square or modestly rounded?

name: Flat bordered cards without shadows
definition: Do cards use thin light borders instead of shadows to separate them?

name: Soft shadows on cards or images
definition: Are cards or featured images lifted with rounded corners and soft drop shadows?

name: Bimodal radii avoiding small rounding
definition: Are border radii either square or large (16px+), with few subtle small radii in between?

name: Effects baked into raster images
definition: Are embossed, metallic or textured effects delivered via images or decorative CSS shapes rather than CSS gradients?

name: Translucent header with backdrop blur
definition: Does the header have a translucent background with backdrop blur?

name: Decorative footer photo with halftone accents
definition: Does the footer use a curved-crop photo with halftone-dot decoration?

name: Decorative glyphs instead of icons
definition: Are decorative marks such as stars and carets rendered as text glyphs rather than SVG icons?

name: Hierarchy without badges or icons
definition: Is hierarchy carried only by weight, case and size, with no badges or decorative icons?

name: Dark overlay on hero photo
definition: Does the hero use a full-bleed photo background darkened by an overlay or gradient to keep text readable?

name: Candid people-centric photography
definition: Does the page use photography of real people and everyday or lifestyle scenes rather than studio or stock art?

name: Text baked into raster images
definition: Are headings, labels, captions or controls delivered as text embedded in images instead of live HTML text?

name: Uniformly cropped thumbnails
definition: Are thumbnails or gallery images cropped to a uniform aspect ratio or frame?

name: Upscaled soft or distorted images
definition: Are small source images upscaled or distorted beyond natural size so they look soft or stretched?

name: Descriptive alt text on images
definition: Do images have descriptive alt text naming their content, organization or following a consistent pattern?

name: Logo tile grid with framing
definition: Are sponsor or partner logos shown in tiles or rows with uniform or inconsistent framing, including combined badge images?

name: Monochrome logo row
definition: Is there a row of grayscale or monochrome partner, press or payment logos?

name: No inline SVG icons
definition: Does the page avoid inline SVG icons, using text glyphs or raster images instead?

name: Colored wash on photos
definition: Are photos tinted with a colored wash or styled to match the brand palette?

name: Gradient overlay on flat tiles
definition: Do promo or placeholder tiles use flat color fields with gradient overlays instead of photos?

name: Hero photo with baked-in text
definition: Does the hero image contain text or seals baked into the picture itself?

name: Mixed image styles
definition: Does imagery mix illustration, clip-art, graphics and photos with inconsistent style?

name: Multicolored distinct-hue icons
definition: Are icons flat illustrations each in a distinct color rather than one uniform set?

name: Raster logo
definition: Is the brand logo a raster image rather than SVG or live text?

name: Rotated collage or multi-panel photos
definition: Does the page present photos as a collage, scattered or multi-panel arrangement?

name: Small inline SVG line icons
definition: Are icons thin-stroke outline SVGs displayed at a uniform size?

name: Cut-out product photos on white
definition: Are product photos isolated cut-outs on white without lifestyle context?

name: Dark photo blending into dark panels
definition: Does dark photography blend into adjoining dark panels, including a decorative full-width photo band?

name: Hand-made illustrated graphics
definition: Does the page use grainy, hand-drawn or decorative illustrations such as maps and line-art?

name: Placeholder video with play icon
definition: Is a video placeholder shown as a rounded dark panel with a centered translucent play icon instead of real video?

name: Repeated logo placement
definition: Does the brand logo appear repeatedly in header, mid-page and footer?

name: Rounded hero photo with shadow
definition: Does the hero photo have rounded corners and a soft drop shadow?

name: SVG wordmark with accent highlight
definition: Is the logo an SVG wordmark with part highlighted in the accent color?

name: Single saturated accent in photo
definition: Does a single saturated accent color in the hero photo stand out against a muted palette?

name: Third-party banner ad inserted
definition: Is a third-party banner advertisement inserted between content sections?

name: Tiled hero strip clipping text
definition: Is the hero a strip of equal tiles cropped from wider banners, clipping their text?

name: Very tall card images
definition: Do cards use very tall images that dominate the page height?

name: No emoji, exclamation marks or em dashes
definition: Is the visible copy free of emoji, exclamation marks and em dashes?

name: Exclamation marks in promotional copy
definition: Does the copy use exclamation marks for an upbeat or enthusiastic tone?

name: Title joined with en dash
definition: Does the page title join its parts with an en dash?

name: Links and CTAs end with arrow glyph
definition: Do links or CTA labels end with an arrow glyph?

name: Formal legal footer text
definition: Does the footer include formal legal or administrative text such as addresses, company numbers, licences or disclaimers?

name: Text-light, link-dense page
definition: Is the page short on text, with few words and many links?

name: Title uses pipe separator
definition: Does the page title or caption text use a pipe character as a separator?

name: Truncated teaser text with ellipsis
definition: Are card titles, teasers or excerpts cut off with a trailing ellipsis?

name: Headings with trailing ellipsis
definition: Do headings end with an ellipsis for an inviting tone?

name: Informal first-person casual voice
definition: Is the copy casual and written in the first person?

name: Machine-paraphrased wording
definition: Does the text read as machine-paraphrased, with awkward synonym substitution?

name: Phone number repeated as contact point
definition: Is the phone number repeated in several places as the main contact?

name: Title Case headings
definition: Are headings and names capitalised on every word?

name: Title joined with em dash
definition: Does the page title join its parts with an em dash?

name: Title repeats H1 wording
definition: Does the page title repeat the wording of the h1?

name: Bold personal sign-off
definition: Does a first-person mission message end with a bold personal sign-off?

name: Brand names repeated with registered marks
definition: Are brand names repeated as logos and inline text with registered marks?

name: Brand-voiced caps fragments, sustainability theme
definition: Does the copy use caps headline fragments and repeat a sustainability theme?

name: Casual p.s. affiliate footer
definition: Does the footer end with a casual 'p.s.' affiliate disclosure and a copyright line below a divider?

name: Concrete numeric facts in descriptions
definition: Do descriptions include concrete numeric figures?

name: Consistent .95 charm pricing
definition: Do all prices end in .95?

name: Formal institutional hero copy
definition: Is the hero copy formal, institutional language about the organization's role?

name: Generic Click Here CTAs with pill buttons
definition: Are CTAs labelled generically, such as 'Click Here', on orange or navy pill buttons?

name: Generic repeated category badge
definition: Do all cards in a section reuse the same generic category badge label?

name: Headings mismatch content
definition: Do headings and product labels fail to match the content or imagery beneath them?

name: Inline glossary-term links in summaries
definition: Do summaries contain inline underlined links to glossary-style terms?

name: Legal disclaimers under forms
definition: Does small-print legal text sit under forms?

name: Legal line with // separators
definition: Does the legal line separate items with '//'?

name: Letter-spaced uppercase red subheading
definition: Is the subheading letter-spaced uppercase in lighter red, followed by a centred keyword-rich paragraph?

name: Lowercase task-phrase link lists
definition: Are link lists short lowercase verb-led phrases with arrow image bullets and dashed dividers?

name: Outlet-prefixed news headlines
definition: Are news headlines prefixed with an outlet name and pipe, possibly in another language?

name: Parenthetical variant markers
definition: Are entries labeled with short parenthetical markers such as (m) and (f)?

name: Placeholder zero metric values
definition: Do listings show placeholder-like zero values for metrics?

name: Plain direct notices
definition: Are notices such as closures stated in plain direct sentences?

name: Playful slogan wordplay in section titles
definition: Do section titles play on the brand slogan with warm phrasing?

name: Same posts repeated across sections
definition: Do the same posts repeat across hero, grids and sidebar lists?

name: Sentence-case headings with eyebrow labels
definition: Are section headings sentence-case value statements with separate one-word eyebrow labels?

name: Social cards with caps, hashtags, emoji
definition: Do social-style cards use all-caps phrases, hashtags and emoji?

name: Title is bare organization name
definition: Is the page title just the organization name with no tagline?

name: Verbatim long catalogue product names
definition: Are long product names shown verbatim including size and variant strings?

name: Wordmark differs from document title
definition: Is the wordmark truncated or misspelled relative to the document title?

name: Semantic landmark elements used
definition: Does the page use semantic landmark elements such as header, nav, main, section and footer?

name: Sparse non-utility semantic class names
definition: Does the markup use few, hand-written semantic class names rather than utility-framework classes?

name: Heading hierarchy skips levels or out of order
definition: Does the heading outline skip levels or appear out of order (e.g., h2 to h4, h3 before h2, sidebar heading before main heading)?

name: Content images have empty alt text
definition: Do content or decorative images (photos, thumbnails, card images) carry empty alt attributes while logos or few others have descriptive alt?

name: Clean ordered heading hierarchy
definition: Does the page have one h1, h2 section titles and h3 card titles in orderly, shallow hierarchy without skipped levels?

name: Link-dense page with few buttons
definition: Are interactive elements mostly anchors, with many links relative to text and few or no buttons?

name: Minimal head metadata, no structured data
definition: Does the head contain only minimal meta tags (charset, viewport, maybe description) and no JSON-LD structured data?

name: All images have alt text
definition: Do all images have alt attributes present, with descriptive or generic text?

name: Article and time elements for items
definition: Are repeated items such as news posts or cards marked up as article elements, with time elements for dates?

name: Page lacks an h1 heading
definition: Does the page have no h1 element, with headings starting at h2 or lower?

name: Address element for contact details
definition: Are contact details marked up with an address element?

name: Quotes use figure and blockquote
definition: Are testimonials or quotes marked up with figure, blockquote and figcaption?

name: Brand-plus-tagline page title
definition: Does the page title follow a short brand plus tagline pattern?

name: Hidden modal dialog with form
definition: Does the page include a hidden modal dialog containing a form such as login?

name: Manual line breaks in copy
definition: Does the page use br elements for line breaks in copy or address blocks?

name: Metric values use b and small elements
definition: Are stat values and labels marked up with b and small elements?

name: Navigation and footer links in lists
definition: Are navigation and footer links marked up as ul/li lists?

name: Single inline style block, no external CSS
definition: Is all styling in one inline style block with no linked external stylesheets?

name: Link-dense relative to text
definition: Does the page have many anchors relative to its word count?

name: Motion limited to transitions only
definition: Does the page use CSS transitions for motion while having no keyframe animations or transforms?

name: Few custom non-utility class names
definition: Does the page use a small set of hand-named classes rather than utility-framework classes?

name: Lightweight page without scripts or SVGs
definition: Is the page free of scripts, external stylesheets and inline SVGs?
